snippet.title: Dark Adelita | Release Date Announcement Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Dark Adelita is launching May 5th, 2026, on Steam! 
Wishlist today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3575650/Dark_Adelita/ 

Dark Adelita is a brutal, 2D action platformer rooted in Mexican folklore. As Angela, a fearless Adelita, fight your way through mythic horrors, dodge deadly traps, and face legendary bosses from Mexico’s past—all while uncovering a supernatural threat born from revolution.
